versions.changelog:
jiaoyuan-skill v0.1.0

- Initial release of the Jiaoyuan "Mindset Engine" skill.
- Enables users to analyze real-world dilemmas using distilled thinking methods from Jiaoyuan’s (Mao Zedong’s) published works.
- Supports Deduction Mode (full analytical walkthrough) and Coaching Mode (Socratic, question-led guidance).
- Provides clear boundaries: methodology focus, not impersonation, advocacy, or professional advice.
- Outlines detailed, stepwise deduction protocol, blending Chinese and English instructions for transparent usage.
- Prioritizes actionable, practical outputs and a conversational yet incisive style.
